trigger.defect: A uniquely resolved duplicate source row could conceal an ambiguous duplicate row for the same subject and gene.

locked_corrections.exact_truth: Reject the subject-gene exact endpoint if any source row is ambiguous, invalid, absent, or conflicts with another row.
locked_corrections.truth_firewall: Freeze predictions for every requested locus before exact or set-valued truth selection.
locked_corrections.primary_estimand: Locus-weighted fixed-denominator exact unordered two-field genotype concordance.
locked_corrections.paired_primary_inference: CR1 subject-clustered t inference with G-1 degrees of freedom.
locked_corrections.multiplicity: Separate descriptive-comparator and exploratory-fitted Holm families within assay; exclude zero-discordance comparisons while displaying them.
locked_corrections.paired_adjusted_interval: Bonferroni-adjusted cluster-t interval over the identical active family.
locked_corrections.sensitivity_inference: Two-sided exact or 1000000-assignment Monte Carlo subject sign-flip test with plus-one correction.
locked_corrections.ambiguity_secondary: Compatibility with any source-allowed unordered two-field genotype.
locked_corrections.g_group_secondary: Compatibility after mapping two-field designations to all compatible official IPD-IMGT/HLA 3.65.0 G groups; not an exact G-group call.

retention_rule: All corrected results are retained regardless of direction.
